changelog.change: Initial shape: the host, the reduction, the line's hash and its page count.
changelog.why: A host serving one template was caught on the 166th page, or never.

description: One line, one host, and how many of that host's pages carried it.

first_seen.description: The published day this line was first counted on.
first_seen.title: First Seen

host.description: The registrable host of the page's canonical address, lowercased. The server that served the template, never the feed that named it.
host.title: Host

last_seen.description: The published day it was last counted on. What the forget window and the eviction order both read.
last_seen.title: Last Seen

line_hash.description: The reduced line, hashed. The line itself is fetched text and is never stored: a sha256 of it cannot carry an instruction (Guardrail #11).
line_hash.title: Line Hash

line_rule.description: Which reduction produced `line_hash`. A read filters to the rule it computes with, so a changed reduction retires its rows by ageing them out rather than by matching nothing and saying the host is clean.
line_rule.title: Line Rule

pages_seen.description: How many DISTINCT pages of this host have carried the line. Distinct pages rather than rows, because a line on one page repeated is one page saying one thing and says nothing about a template.
pages_seen.title: Pages Seen

title: ChromeLineRow
